# CIT-P review, W2-11 round 1

The CIT-P `docs/changes/W2-11-CIT-P.md` judged against the diff 4c064bab..095167b8 (64 files, 13 commits):

with their reference files, the version lines of every kernel skill, the DEC-866 sentences of
`roles/orchestrator.md`, and their rulesync sources. Read-only. No suite re-run (DEC-959 item 1). Single
read-only commands only: the skill validator (all nine touched skills and the template: no finding) and the
adapter check (exactly the 16 copies the CIT-P names as `GENERATED_DIFFERS`, nothing else). Judged under
ADR-0001's threat model with the two questions.

governance folder or `.claude/`; the held-out names; fixed ceilings; owner commits; "tests first / before
implementation"; full-suite runs outside the nightly; entries marked SUPERSEDED or Changed by.

  test-design and qa-review skills, or the skill template. Specifically:

    model's full window (DEC-837, DEC-838).
  - Policy 2's four refusals with the held-out file names readable, in every brief (DEC-820). DEC-508's and
    DEC-525's refusals are removed from the skill.
  - "No fixed number of tickets in flight" (DEC-847).
  - Decision-record commits; no worker or lead puts `Role: owner` or `Decided-by:` on a commit (DEC-861,

  - The parallel work order everywhere (DEC-959 item 7, DEC-963). "Red first" now means red against the

  kind); Escalation (P3, P2, P1, Emergency, and to whom); Never ("reminders only: the guard decides");
  Sources at the end.
- The body is under about 150 lines, with reference files one level deep and no further links.
- Three scenarios, each with a situation, expected behaviour and pass line. The commit with the scenarios
  (`adeda5b88c69`) is older than the commit with the text (`99dd5ca5235d`).
